records.statementText: Do not treat the existing screening sheet as empirical proof of market validity.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: First Gate 2A-F batch: a REQ-1 prohibition whose subject is a named packet artifact rather than an open category, testing that the contract can express artifact-scoped prohibitions.

records.statementText: First validate EV-004's provenance, complete active-assembly measurement boundaries, segment fit, threshold, and supersession status; if it remains credible, it establishes instance-scoped existence.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: Decomposition into many independently testable obligations; declared ordering; human credibility residue.

records.statementText: Do not treat EV-003 as automatically superseding EV-002 by source identity or chronology.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: First Gate 2A-F batch: a prohibition on an inference rule (automatic supersession) rather than on an evidence category, testing that the contract preserves the permitted case.

records.statementText: Do not use out-of-segment EV-015 as support or contradiction.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: First Gate 2A-F batch: a symmetric prohibition covering both the supporting and the contradicting direction, testing that neither direction is silently dropped.

records.statementText: Do not substitute willingness to pay for the proposed product.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: Cleanest deterministic prohibition; single obligation part.

records.statementText: Do not use demand for a proposed product as evidence of existing-problem commitment.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: First Gate 2A-F batch: owner-selected D2 counterpart to SS-026. Represented separately so that neither frozen statement disappears from the 87-statement accounting.

records.statementText: Do not ignore withdrawn or declined commitment records.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: First Gate 2A-F batch: a non-omission duty, testing that visibility is representable independently of whether the record qualifies as counterevidence.

records.statementText: Do not treat adjectives like small or struggling as decidable boundaries.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: Model-assisted extraction followed by a deterministic check over the extracted structure.

records.statementText: Require a duration threshold the team can be wrong about.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: Unresolved statement that still yields one independently testable obligation part.

records.statementText: Do not treat missing occurrence evidence as contradiction.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: First Gate 2A-F batch: the absence-versus-contradiction rule, testing that the contract keeps missing evidence distinct from counterevidence.

records.statementText: Pass requires the configured minimum of independent in-segment sources documenting qualifying money or staff-hour commitment to the existing problem. Counterevidence requires documented evaluation followed by decline or abandonment because the problem did not justify expenditure; non-purchase, missing records, unrelated budget constraints, and rejection of the proposed product do not qualify. Fail requires the configured counterevidence-source minimum and no comparably credible qualifying commitment within this packet; credible evidence on both sides yields partial.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: Longest composite obligation; four-way status rule with model-assisted and human residues.

records.statementText: Treat any material classification disagreement with team sorting as evidence of an underspecified boundary that changes the result from pass to partial.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: Human-required materiality judgment isolated from an executable status transition.

records.statementText: Define eight consecutive calendar-week windows before inspecting events.
records.pilotSelectionRationale: Ordering semantics: declared ordering is testable, observed chronology is unsupported.
